text:
zoe_billing: RelayAI opened a dispute: Feb invoice shows ~200k tokens billed to burst after a scheduled capacity migration. They think reserved capacity should have followed. attaching excerpt.

maria_finance: invoice id?

zoe_billing: INV-RLY-2026-02. customer says "we migrated reserved pool during low-traffic window; traffic was routed to APAC and billed burst".

tom_ops: quick look: migration window had a short period where node labels weren't propagated; routing fell back to burst. sanitized meters:
```
meter: customer=relayai region=ap-south bucket=burst tokens=120000 ts=2026-02-20T02:12:10Z
meter: customer=relayai region=ap-south bucket=burst tokens=80000 ts=2026-02-20T02:30:05Z
meter: customer=relayai region=eu-west bucket=reserved tokens=900000 ts=2026-02-20T01:45:00Z
```

tom_ops: so 200k burst tokens.

ana_prod: was this migration customer-initiated? if so, were docs clear about transient billing during pool moves?

zoe_billing: they say it was coordinated with support; support ticket TS-8821.

rick_sales: customer expects a remediation; they're strategic. propose provisional credit for the burst tokens while ops finalizes RCA.

maria_finance: what's the burst unit price? we've got a special pricing: $0.0042/token.

zoe_billing: calc: 200000 * 0.0042 = $840 provisional credit.

claire_cfo: approve provisional credit up to $1k for CX. require RCA and ticket link included in memo.

metering-bot: export ready s3://redwood-metering/exports/relayai/2026-02-20/2098765432-export.csv

zoe_billing: I'll send a hold note and apply provisional credit $840 (subject to RCA). Tom, file OPS ticket and attach RCA.

tom_ops: OPS-7284 opened to investigate label propagation during pool migration. ETA 48h. will attach audit.

maria_finance: proceed with provisional credit. tag invoice INV-RLY-2026-02 as under review.

zoe_billing: provisional credit applied and customer notified. closing until OPS-7284 completes. :white_check_mark:
